root_motivation: **Who.** Joe as operator of mcphost-1 (one 1.9 GB SQLite file in WAL mode serving every tenant), rb who reads its `prune_log` and the live judge that reads `/contract.json`.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given the § Fixture (6,000 due subjects, 20 heavy) and a host.tool_call loop on a live tenant, When the scheduled sweep and admin.prune_now start together with a budget one sweep cannot finish, Then one reports busy, every subject is deleted exactly once over two or more batches, held_over equals the remainder, loop p95 stays under 250 ms and under max(2× the idle baseline, 50 ms), and per-batch wall time in the PR body.

Given a subject with a row in every table naming tenants by key or name (enumerated at test time; two-sided set = § Cascade) and, per two-sided column, a synthetic and a claimed two-marker tenant's row naming it, When sweeps run, Then it is held, held_entangled names each claimed-owned column, no row of either tenant changes; claimed rows gone, it is purged, synthetic rows get their § Cascade outcome and no row names it.

Given the migrated schema, When a test lists every foreign-key column referencing tenants through pragma_foreign_key_list, Then each has an index whose first column it is, the migration adding the missing ones takes the next free number at land time and also creates namespace_tombstones holding each tenant-delete admin_events namespace, and dropping any one of those indexes inside the test fails it naming the table and column.

Given implicit synthetic unclaimed rows minted before the floor, When the sweep runs with the window elapsed since the floor, Then each is disabled idle_expired with a lifecycle event, the expire stage stops at the wall budget reporting held_over, a row idle under the window is untouched, and the sweep with no prior prune_log row carrying purge_due_unix logs pre_floor with a ≤ 200-row pre_floor_sample, no key or address.

Given two-marker rows disabled idle_expired or self_offboard, When sweeps run on a mock clock, Then none is deleted before MAX(last_seen or created, last lifecycle event, floor) + grace, a sweep with no prior prune_log row carrying purge_due_unix only reports would_purge and cross_refs, later sweeps delete via delete_tenant_as logging tenant_purge_synthetic; each batch ends in incremental_vacuum(PURGE_VACUUM_PAGES), no VACUUM.

Given purge-due and pre-floor rows, When admin.prune_now is called with dry_run true, Then it returns would_expire, pre_floor, would_purge, purge_due_unix, cross_refs by column and class and held_entangled, writes no prune_log row and deletes nothing; admin.funnel carries tenants_synthetic_purged; contract dump shows the § Contract keys and contract --check fails when a constant moves.

Given the § Classes rows, When sweeps pass the window and grace, Then only the both-markers unclaimed row gains event, flag and deletion, the other eight none, even if a class flips between mark and delete; grace env off purges nothing, idle-days env off disables or purges nothing; a disabled subject's old tenant_key gets tenant_key_invalid and moves no due date, and a keyless new peer still mints, never a purged namespace.

Given prod after this PRD's deploy, When the AC 8 command in § Live evidence commands runs from the build host with no credential, Then jq prints true on purge.grace_days 14, floor_rule idle_from_floor, zero_disables false and self_offboard among the purge reasons, and the last line is jq_rc=0 (Live; evidence: AC 8 command in § Live evidence commands showing true and jq_rc=0)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (prod; evidence: AC 8 command in the PRD Live evidence commands)

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
